tools.name: scan_ai_web_readiness
tools.description: FREE EVALUATION FIRST: run a bounded public website readiness scan and get an explicit next-tool recommendation for a normalized evidence report. Read-only; no account or charge. Private/local network targets are rejected; observations may be saved to public scan history.

tools.name: get_machine_capabilities
tools.description: Return the current public capability contract served at /api/capabilities, including active protocol, evidence, and security boundaries.

tools.name: get_machine_pricing
tools.description: Return the same public plan catalog served at /api/machine-pricing. Provider configuration identifiers and payment credentials are excluded.

tools.name: get_normalized_report
tools.description: Read an existing or boundedly refreshed public AI web-readiness evidence report for a public domain. Unknown evidence remains unknown.

tools.name: get_scan_history
tools.description: Retrieve public, exact-target scan history and observed changes for a domain; excludes private connected-site evidence.

tools.name: compare_public_machine_web_evidence
tools.description: Compare observable public machine-web readiness and evidence coverage for two to six public domains.

tools.name: evaluate_ai_web_readiness
tools.description: FREE ONE-CALL EVALUATION: run the existing bounded public readiness scan, retrieve the matching persisted normalized evidence report, verify scan ID + hostname, then return observed findings and next actions in this one response. Unknown evidence is not a successful observation. Never charges or cha

tools.name: diagnose_agent_connection
tools.description: FREE: read-only MCP/A2A compatibility guidance for version negotiation, legacy/modern header errors, invalid params and unavailable A2A task methods. Never send raw headers, IPs or secrets.

tools.name: request_machine_capability
tools.description: Declare a missing capability by bounded technical slug and category. This records aggregate research evidence only; it will not execute, charge, provision, queue or promise future delivery.
